scope.art_and_flight_basis: Original small game helicopter with cabin, skids, tail boom, main rotor and tail rotor. Arcade acceleration, hovering and bounded vertical flight, not an engineering flight model or a representation of actual aviation operations. The ground helipad is an authored marking on existing Seoul Plaza terrain, not a new support plane or a real helipad claim.
scope.landing: Native existing terrain only: shallow grade and positive support under both skids. Building roofs, water, private ground and unsupported positions do not allow E dismount. A validated external player teleport returns the game aircraft to its certified home pad only when the full native aircraft volume is clear; otherwise it holds and retries.
